visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male chef wearing a black apron with a white "MEAT" logo stands behind a charcoal grill; a large black cylindrical exhaust hood hangs above as orange flames flare up from the coals. (2) Close-up shots feature a beef bowl where a bright orange egg yolk is mixed into cooked beef slices, followed by a detailed view of a multi-layered mille crepe cake slice on a white plate. (3) Hands wearing white latex gloves use a sharp knife to precision-cut a slab of raw, highly marbled beef on a white surface. (4) Various types of raw beef, including Prime beef strips and cubes, are shown being arranged on a platter and then placed onto a wire grill over glowing red charcoal. (5) Thick slabs of pork chops and pink slices of pork neck are grilled; tongs are used to flip the meat as fat drippings create smoke and small flames. (6) A series of seafood dishes are showcased: scallops topped with salmon roe, a crab shell filled with crab meat and a melting square of yellow butter, and large grey raw prawns. (7) Clams are cooked in a shallow metal pan with broth, and a spoon lifts one out; sauce is drizzled over a beef bowl. (8) A tall cocktail glass with a lime wedge is presented, followed by shots of an empty private dining room with brown leather seating and a TV showing a music video. (9) The restaurant's interior bar and seating area are shown with several patrons, and the final shot displays the modern dark-colored storefront of "D-Meat" at night.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 巨蛋商圈附近的燒肉店. (2) [Subtitle]: 還有吃到丼飯、甜點、和調酒. (3) [Subtitle]: 老闆嚴選肉品 自家精修處理. (4) [Subtitle]: 愛吃牛推薦來一份美國Prime特選牛小排. (5) [Subtitle]: 口感軟嫩充滿肉香. (6) [Subtitle]: 美國牛肋條肉質厚實. (7) [Subtitle]: 烤到微酥更好吃. (8) [Subtitle]: 不吃牛就選擇最高等級的Bellota伊比利梅花豬排. (9) [Subtitle]: 豬肉非常鮮嫩多汁 有濃醇香氣. (10) [Subtitle]: Bellota伊比利松阪豬 軟嫩Q彈 滋味鮮美. (11) [Subtitle]: 喜歡海鮮就加點干貝馬卡龍 直接吃不用烤. (12) [Subtitle]: 這個美味蟹堡是松葉蟹絲加奶油燒烤 吃起來綿密鮮香超下飯. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有整尾野生大草蝦 生食級紋甲花枝. (14) [Subtitle]: 加清酒煮的蛤蜊 搭配超濃蒜香蛤蜊雞湯. (15) [Subtitle]: 配一碗爆漿月見和牛丼飯更飽足. (16) [Subtitle]: 記得追加千層蛋糕和調酒. (17) [Subtitle]: 二樓有包廂可以唱歌哦. (18) [Subtitle]: 快去訂位吧. (19) [Logo]: D-Meat 燒肉餐酒館 高雄市左營區新慶路288號. (20) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨 下次再一起吃美食囉.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop background music starts immediately at a fast tempo. A male narrator introduces the restaurant in a high-arousal, friendly tone. (2) A sharp sizzling SFX triggers as the grill appears; the narrator's speech rate increases to describe the beef bowl and crepe cake over a steady electronic beat. (3) A metallic scraping or cutting sound is heard faintly as meat is sliced. BGM continues with a driving bassline. (4) Multiple short sizzling transients occur as raw meat is placed on the grill. The narrator remains enthusiastic with rising intonation. (5) A liquid bubbling sound occurs as the crab butter melts, followed by the clink of a metal spoon against a shell. (6) Music persists through the final phase where the narrator lowers his pitch slightly for a professional sign-off and location summary.
